summary: @servicetitan/hash-browser-router preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string/number-array obfuscation and a shuffling routine (WV8StW), unrelated to the advertised React hash-router functionality and not referenced by the package's dist/ code. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based scanners and runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on every installer machine. The package otherwise ships a legitimate-looking React router dist/ tree under the @servicetitan scope, consistent with namespace impersonation or maintainer account takeover grafting a dropper onto real source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
